title: Psychonauts
shortDescription: Razputin infiltrates Whispering Rock summer camp entering the eccentric, surreal mental worlds of diverse characters.
historicalSignificance: Tim Schafer's cult classic masterpiece celebrated for unmatched comedic creativity and brilliant level concepts like the Milkman Conspiracy.
